Shell.headline: A clear workspace to manage your business.
Shell.description: Access your company workspaces and the management tools linked to your account, with permissions organized by company.
Shell.footer: PolyGest · For business owners and teams.

Login.title: Sign in
Login.description: Enter the credentials associated with your account to access your workspace.
Login.checkEmail: If this address can be registered, a confirmation message has been sent. Check your inbox and spam folder.

errors.missing-fields: Enter your email address and password.

Register.title: Create an account
Register.description: Create your PolyGest access to set up your first company workspace.

ForgotPassword.title: Reset your password
ForgotPassword.description: Enter the email address associated with your account. If an account can receive a recovery link, a message will be sent.

ResetPassword.title: Choose a new password
ResetPassword.description: Set a new password to secure your PolyGest account.

ResetPassword.successDescription: You can now continue to your workspace.

errors.password-too-short: The password must contain at least 8 characters.
errors.password-too-long: The password must not exceed 128 characters.
errors.invalid-session: The recovery session is invalid or has expired. Request a new link.
errors.update-failed: The password could not be updated. Check the security requirements and try again.

Onboarding.title: Create your company workspace
Onboarding.description: Enter your company details to start organizing your business with PolyGest.

WorkspaceNotice.title: Your workspace is ready
WorkspaceNotice.description: The English translation of the dashboard and management modules is in progress. For this first step, those screens remain available in French.
